node.statement: Applying the preceding criterion separately to all X=U bold-dot V and X=U^dagger would identify exactly the values of u_grp used in mu_grp and sigma_grp, so it would suffice for the parent transport. However, lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws does not state membership of those inputs in the explicit S_delta together with typed witnesses h_X satisfying X=u_grp(X) bold-dot h_X for this Pi_delta; it only refers to an unspecified polar map. Hence the registered inputs do not supply even this weaker pointwise synchronization condition.
